description: A large concert hall with a vaulted wooden ceiling and skylights. A conductor in a black tailcoat stands on a podium seen from behind, arms raised. In front of him is a big orchestra with strings, a harp, brass and cellos. Behind them rise tiers of a huge choir: women in white dresses and men in black tie. A pipe organ fills the gallery at the back. Audience silhouettes sit in the lower foreground. No visible text or frame.
